stages.summary: A real RGB crop read from the verified refit cache. The stored optical values are scaled from 8-bit digital numbers to [0, 1].
stages.title: Raw optical source

stages.summary: The participant reference labels and source-validity mask stay aligned. Invalid support is set to ignore ID 6; the training loss also ignores that class ID.
stages.title: Reference and validity

stages.summary: The outlined window is the exact 512 × 512 draw at these scene pixel coordinates. It was selected by the refit coverage and class-aware schedule.
stages.title: Scheduled training window

stages.summary: All three aligned outputs come from the Python training augment() function with the recorded draw seed and the locked baseline recipe.
stages.title: Seeded augmentation

stages.summary: The trained residual-identity RGB adapter and ImageNet mean/std normalization produce the actual DINOv3 tensor. The PNG reverses normalization only for display and is clipped to [0, 1].
stages.title: Backbone input

stages.summary: These four images are deterministic PCA renderings of feature maps captured from the real checkpoint at blocks 3, 6, 9, and 12. They are not attention maps.
stages.title: Recorded encoder features

stages.summary: The six-class argmax comes from one identity forward pass of the bound final refit checkpoint on the same augmented training draw.
stages.title: Dense prediction

stages.summary: This crop-only confusion count shows how valid reference/prediction pairs are accumulated. It is an in-sample illustration, not independent benchmark evidence.
stages.title: Training-sample errors
